descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for invoking this operation is 5.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
